after: An expression is code that produces a value. For whole numbers, `+` adds, `-` subtracts, and `*` multiplies.

Here, `=` means assign the result to the name on the left. It does not ask whether two numbers are equal.
Use unquoted numbers for this calculation. Quotes mark text. An integer type can hold only a limited range of whole numbers.
